yield_: five taxes' yield as a share of the costings: Table 6.14's 80% and 120% scenarios as the ends, mode at the costing
caseload: caseload elasticity: partF.CASE low / central / high (Table 6.14g's 0.56)
eti: taxable-income elasticity of the response to the family-payment tapers: Table 6.13 / F4-106's 0.1, 0.2, 0.4
mpe: labour response (income effect per dollar of net gain), scaled into the child payment's income effect: Tables 6.13, F4-114
overrun: cost overrun, A$bn a year nominal from 2028-29: Table 6.14g's A$1bn and A$2bn cases; one-sided, mode nil
lift_k: floor costing: the model's own (mode) to the PBO's basis (x1.34, Table 6.14g)
calibration: household calibration: central, pensioners' other income 25% lower, FTB-consistent (Table 6.14g's rows); equal weights ASSUMPTION
ai: AI path: the paper's displacement scenarios (Table 6.18b; GDP held); the paper gives no probabilities, so 10% moderate and 5% severe is an ASSUMPTION
